name: Ring of Open Mind
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of mind shielding. Instead of granting immunity to detect thoughts, discern lies or any attempt to magically discern her alignment the wearer’s mind is completely open to all who would try to see into it. The wearer suffers a -10 penalty to all saves versus mind affecting spells and effects.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it. In this event, the ring may be removed but the ring and enchantment remain intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of mind shielding

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
